anchors.reason: The dataset concerns EEG/fNIRS for semantic decoding, while the paper discusses lung microbiome and COVID-19, showing no topical or methodological link.

anchors.paper_title: Implementing a calibration-free SSVEP-based BCI system with 160 targets
anchors.reason: The paper describes a general SSVEP-BCI system with 160 targets, which is topically related to EEG but does not introduce or describe the specific simultaneous EEG/fNIRS dataset.

metadata.methods_description: EEG data were acquired using a BioSemi ActiveTwo system with 64 electrodes positioned according to the 10-20 system at 2048 Hz sampling rate, supplemented with earlobe reference electrodes, galvanic skin response measurement, and respiration monitoring. fNIRS data were collected simultaneously using a NIRx NIRScoutXP continuous wave imaging system with 8 light sources and 4 detectors in integrated fNIRS-EEG montages (frontal and temporal configurations).
